So he is the venue keeper facilitating prostitution. The crime is "容留他人卖淫" which is a crime under Chinese criminal law: "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫" (organizing, forcing, inducing, harboring, introducing prostitution). The appropriate charge is "容留他人卖淫罪". In the examples, they label as "容留他人吸毒" for drug case, "容留他人吸毒" etc. For prostitution, they used "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫". In one example: "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫;引诱、容留、介绍卖淫". So they list multiple crimes if multiple aspects. Here only container. So answer: [罪名]容留他人卖淫<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: He voluntarily reported and cooperated, but that doesn't add other crimes. So single crime.
